clipboard.subscribe userGestureId is a Studio-issued trusted-interaction token, one-shot and bound to pluginId, sceneId, operation and permissionGeneration; provider-chosen strings never authorize.
MCP consent is one-shot and bound to serverRef, toolName, schema SHA-256, runId and argument digest.
Host enforces four MCP calls per run, never trusts a provider readOnly boolean, and cancels calls on revocation.
Desktop subscription is per format, visible and revocable; clipboard writes require a user gesture and emit an origin marker.

OCR text is local-only, bounded, cancellable, and never automatically sent to a model or saved.
All desktop callbacks return unsupported on unimplemented platforms.
MCP argument digests use SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes; Host must freeze canonicalization and test cross-language vectors before implementation.
